mechanism: Cross-reactivity risk due to shared beta-lactam structure; cephalosporins have 1-3% cross-reactivity with penicillins, particularly in patients with penicillin hypersensitivity history.
action: Avoid concurrent use in patients with documented penicillin allergy; if beta-lactam therapy is essential, use cephalosporins only in patients with non-IgE mediated reactions or distant penicillin exposure without severe reactions.
